name: Venezuela (1859–1863)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and red, with twenty blue five-pointed stars in two rows of ten across the yellow stripe.
history: Flag raised by the federalists during the Federal War (1859–1863), which placed twenty blue stars on the yellow stripe for the twenty provinces of the federation. After the federal victory the flag of 1863 reduced the stars to seven, in white, on the blue stripe.
